entities.name: Bogdan Gavrilović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bogdan Gavrilović was a Serbian mathematician, physicist, university professor and academic. He received his doctorate in sciences mathematiques from the University of Budapest in 1887. He served twice as the Rector of the University of Belgrade and was elected three times as president of the Serbian Royal Academy (1931–1937).
